info.title: CF Meet public API — developer-platform
info.description: Section 50 developer / enterprise control plane, served through the public API Gateway. Human console operations use the verified CF Meet session (verified by the Meeting Service through the session bridge); server automation uses scoped Platform Access credentials where noted. Organizations, projects and environments are Developer Platform metadata over canonical Platform Access tenants, applications and environments: Platform Access remains the only identity, credential and scope authority. Non-members get NOT_FOUND for another tenant's resources. Every response carries X-Request-Id. Section 53 central webhooks: the Developer Console manages an environment's webhook subscriptions, delivery and attempt history and replays under /v1/environments/{environmentId}/webhooks* and /webhook-deliveries/*. The machine-credential webhook API keeps Calling's public contract and paths (cfmeet.calling.http-api /v1/webhooks*); the API Gateway re-points it to the Developer Platform at the cut-over (cfmeet.developer-platform.internal-api documents the served routes). Section 50 service accounts: OWNER / ADMIN create, suspend and resume an environment's Platform Access service accounts under /v1/environments/{environmentId}/service-accounts* (delegated to Platform Access, the only store; DEVELOPER reads; machine credentials need `service_accounts.manage`); API credentials stay Section 54. 1.4.0 (Part VI Chapters 10–13): Section 54 credential self-service (create with the secret once, list, read, rotate with bounded overlap, revoke, suspend / resume, quota restrictions), the scope registry and project scope grants, the organization credential policy; Section 55 production-access requests (submit, read, cancel, activate) and status, environment usage (rollups, facts, CSV / JSON export, warnings) and limits; Section 57 support profiles. 1.5.0 (Part VI Chapters 14–18): activity filters (`projectId`, `action`) and cursor pagination of credentials and production-access requests.

platformCredential.description: A Platform Access API credential (server-side only; never in a browser).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replays return the original response; reuse with a different request is IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. One-time secrets are never replayed.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response is the stored result of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key (no new effect).

platform-developer.common.v1.Error.description: Error envelope (Cache-Control: no-store). Messages never contain an identifier, credential, token or database text.

summary.description: Safe change summary: opaque ids, codes and display metadata only — never secrets, credentials, contacts or E2EE material.

platform-developer.control.v1.BillingAcc.description: Billing-account REFERENCE metadata. Never card, bank, charge or balance data.

Internal reads also carry the versioned snapshot consuming services cache.
